description:
gf2-sim permanent_campaign::coordinator::tests::transaction_refuses_symlinked_writer_ancestors_without_external_effects failed once with a fast (61ms) assertion failure during the merged-tree CI for the 5233867e merge (2026-09-01, tree 612a1519), then passed on immediate isolated re-run under the same ci-test/ci profiles (51ms). The raw assertion text was lost because cargo-ci.sh keeps step logs in a mktemp dir removed on exit. Two observations for the investigator: (a) under the plain debug profile the test appears to hang, which is only unoptimized SHA-256 of the large debug test binary in the fixture (current_exe hashing) hitting nextest's 10s slow-timeout — raise the per-test timeout or precompute; (b) the transient ran concurrently with an unrelated worktree build on the same host.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The flake's root cause is identified and fixed, or the test is made robust against the identified environmental condition, with the reasoning recorded.
- [hard] REQ-02: cargo-ci.sh preserves failing-step raw output beyond process exit so future one-shot failures keep their assertion text.
title: Flaky: symlinked-writer-ancestor coordinator test failed once (61ms assertion) in a merged-tree CI run
